about: Fixes to tools/guides/mechtools-3.29.json found by the review of the mechanic tools (2026-11-06). The research file stays the untouched record; make_guides.py applies these before building the tools data. cite = indexes into that topic's own source list in the research file.

value.name: Liquid Cowardice
value.why: You lose 10 Resolve every time you use a flask. Builds that press flasks often drain their Resolve fast, and PoE Vault's affliction tier list rates it run-ending.

corrections.reason: The research left this minor affliction out although its own cited tier list (poe-vault, source 0) rates it Run-Ending; the effect text is on poedb Sanctum_league (source 8). Confirmed 3/3 by the review.

corrections.match: The temple has 13 room slots: the 12 you shape plus the fixed Apex of Atzoatl, which holds the Vaal Omnitect.
corrections.value: The temple has 13 rooms: the fixed Entrance, the fixed Apex of Atzoatl (the Vaal Omnitect) and the 11 rooms the 12 incursions shape.
corrections.reason: The rule contradicted the same data's own rules (the Entrance and the Apex are fixed; the temple starts in 11 connectable spaces). Confirmed 3/3 by the review.
